title: At the hotel
summary: Checking in at a hotel, getting the room key, asking about breakfast and Wi-Fi, and a small problem in the room.
phrases: Excuse me, I have a problem. |
lines: Good evening! Welcome to Hotel Linde.
Good evening. I've booked a room.
Very good. What's your name, please?
My name is Lena Berger.
Ah yes, a single room for three nights.
Exactly. Do you need my ID?
Yes, please. Thank you very much.
Here is your key. Room two hundred and twelve.
Where is the lift?
Over there on the left, next to the stairs.
When is breakfast?
From seven to ten, in the restaurant.
Is there coffee and tea too?
Of course. Coffee, tea and fresh bread.
And what's the Wi-Fi password?
The password is on the card.
Great, thanks a lot!
You're welcome. Have a nice evening!
Excuse me, I have a problem.
Oh, what's wrong?
The shower in my room is cold.
I'm sorry about that. I'll call the technician right away.
How long will it take?
About twenty minutes.
Would you like a tea at the bar in the meantime?
Yes, please. That's very kind.
